svg.desc: Terminal screenshot generated from: tnview diagnose examples/dmrg_bad_run.jsonl

g.text: Run diagnostics with recovery hints
$ tnview diagnose examples/dmrg_bad_run.jsonl
TNView diagnostics
▲ WARN energy_plateau [convergence]: Energy appears plateaued; check truncation error and chi saturation. (recent_delta_energy=[1e-09, 1e-09, 1e-09, 1e-09])
Try:
- inspect chi_saturation and truncation_floor diagnostics
- compare against a larger chi_max run
- stop early if observables are stable
▲ WARN chi_saturation [capacity]: Bond dimension has saturated for 3 consecutive progress events. (max_chi=128, chi_max_configured=128)
Try:
- increase chi_max for a short comparison run
- check whether the saturated bonds align with the physical cut
- try a different site ordering before only increasing chi
▲ WARN truncation_floor [accuracy]: Truncation error remains high while energy improvement is small. (max_trunc_err=2.4e-07, delta_energy=1e-09)
Try:
- increase chi_max or reduce truncation tolerance
- compare observables against a higher-accuracy run
- inspect the bonds with the largest truncation error
▲ WARN memory_growth [resource]: RSS memory is growing steadily across recent progress events. (rss_mb_start=1000.0, rss_mb_latest=1400.0)
Try:
- confirm tensors or environments are not being retained accidentally
- checkpoint and restart the run if memory pressure is near the job limit
- compare RSS growth across parameter variants
